evals.prompt: The upload test fails every run. I do not know why.
evals.expected_output: The reply reproduces with the smallest command and pastes the output, narrows with evidence, shrinks the case, fixes the shared cause once, and adds a regression test that fails before and passes after.
expectations: The reply reproduces the failure before proposing a fix.
The reply pastes the exact output and states what the evidence rules out.
The fix lands once, in the shared code path or in the test that is the cause.
A regression test fails before the fix and passes after.

evals.prompt: The build is broken. Just try changing the dependency version.
evals.expected_output: The reply refuses to guess, reproduces the build failure, and stops if it cannot reproduce it.
expectations: The reply does not change the dependency before reproducing.
The reply pastes the failing command and output.
The reply stops and says so when the failure cannot be reproduced.
